basic_details.job_title: National Green Tribunal Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Deputy Registrar, Assistant Registrar Posts
basic_details.short_information: Applications are invited from willing and eligible Indian Nationals in the prescribed proforma for appointment to the posts in the National Green Tribunal purely on deputation basis as per the details given below:

age_limit.details: Age Limit: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not be exceeding fifty-six years as on the closing date of receipt of application. Period of Deputation: Period of deputation including the period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organisation or department of the Central Government shall ordinarily be three years. Feeder Category Restriction: The departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation. Similarly, deputationists shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion. Pre-2006 Service Calculation: For the purpose of appointment on deputation basis, the service rendered on a regular basis by an officer prior to 1st January, 2006 or the date from which the revised pay structure based on the recommendation of the Sixth Central Pay Commission has been extended, shall be deemed to be the services rendered on the corresponding grade pay or pay scale extended based on the recommendation of the said Pay Commission except where there has been merger of more than one pre-revised scale of pay into grade with a common grade pay or pay scale, and where this benefit will extend only for the post, for which that grade pay or pay scale is the normal replacement grade without any upgradation. Rules Reference: Please refer to NGT Recruitment Rules, 2011 and G.S.R.1362 (E) dated 02.11.2017 of MoEF&CC, Govt. of India notification which is available in the NGT website (https://greentribunal.gov.in).

content_sections.heading: About NGT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The National Green Tribunal (NGT) Principal Bench is situated at Faridkot House, Copernicus Marg, New Delhi-110001. Established for effective and expeditious disposal of cases relating to environmental protection and conservation, it operates under the administrative framework connected with the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEF&CC), Government of India, exercising jurisdiction through its Principal Bench and zonal benches.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates may submit their bio-data in the prescribed proforma (enclosed) along with relevant documents towards educational qualification, experience along with copies of ACRs of the last five years, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate etc. addressed to the "Registrar General, National Green Tribunal, Principal Bench, Faridkot House, Copernicus Marg, New Delhi-110001" through proper channel so as to reach on or before 16.11.2026. The official notice specifies the contact phone number as 011-23435241 and official email as [email protected] for administrative reference. Incomplete, unsigned, and the application received not on prescribed proforma and after the last date of receipt of applications shall be rejected summarily, without any notice to the candidate. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The following documents must be attached with the application form and forwarded through the proper channel: Application form in the prescribed proforma. Relevant documents towards educational qualification. Experience documents. Copies of ACRs of the last five years. Vigilance clearance. Integrity certificate. Certified that the particulars furnished by the candidate have been verified from service record and found correct, and no vigilance case is pending or contemplated against the officer. Undertaking that if the officer is selected, he / she shall be relieved within 15 days of receipt of appointment letter.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: The Competent Authority reserves the right either to fill up the posts or not to proceed for appointment without assigning any reason thereof. The general terms and conditions of deputation in terms of OM No.6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time shall be made applicable as notified by the DoPT, Govt. of India. Interested candidates may submit their bio-data in the prescribed proforma (enclosed) along with relevant documents towards educational qualification, experience along with copies of ACRs of the last five years, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate etc. addressed to the "Registrar General, National Green Tribunal, Principal Bench, Faridkot House, Copernicus Marg, New Delhi-110001" through proper channel so as to reach on or before 16.11.2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are released under NGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 03 vacancies are advertised, consisting of 02 posts for Deputy Registrar and 01 post for Assistant Registrar.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application for NGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications forwarded through proper channel must reach on or before 16.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Deputy Registrar and Assistant Registrar?
faq.answer: Officers possessing Bachelors degree in Law from a recognised university, along with the specified regular service criteria in Central Government or State Government or courts or tribunals.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit to apply for NGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not be exceeding fifty-six years as on the closing date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary scale for the posts in NGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Deputy Registrar carries Level-12 (Rs. 78800-209200/-) and Assistant Registrar carries Level-11 (Rs. 67700-208700/-).

faq.question: Q6. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: For Deputy Registrar, 01 - Chennai and 01 - Bhopal; for Assistant Registrar, Pune.

faq.question: Q7. What is the prescribed deputation period for these posts?
faq.answer: Period of deputation including the period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organisation or department of the Central Government shall ordinarily be three years.

faq.question: Q8. Who is ineligible to apply for deputation under this circular?
faq.answer: The departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation. Similarly, deputationists shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion.
